kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.bait.hari_ini: Today's reward is given; play for the beauty of the verse.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.batas_j: The cap rises with your cultivation band. A market you flood becomes saturated and recovers slowly.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.harga_k: No prices noted yet. Visit a themed town's market to note them.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.infami_: Barely known. The righteous hunters pay you no mind.
Your name is whispered. The dark market gives better prices, the hunters start taking notes.
Your name is famous in the dark world. Righteous hunters may waylay you on the road.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.k_jelas: Deliver the sealed crates before time runs out. An opened or lost crate eats your deposit.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.kosong: You know no themed town yet.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.lewat: This week's cap is passed: extra profit is skimmed by the town traders.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.nama_ge: Your name in the dark world
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.pasar.b: Cheapest in its home town. Carry it to another themed town and check the ledger for the best route.
This town's own goods; 16 of each per day for you.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.pasar.j: The traders are waiting for the next caravan.
Come back with goods from another town.
Each unit you sell pushes this town's price down; saturation recovers one unit every world hour. The total on the button is an upper estimate.
Weekly profit cap passed: sale prices are halved until the new week.
Trade goods in your pack. The price drops a little with every unit you sell in the same town.
Traders here will not touch this. Contraband is taken only by a fence.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.pasar.k: No local goods for sale here today.
Your pack holds no trade goods. Buy where they are made, sell far away.
You need eight units of one good to seal a crate.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.pasar.l: This week's profit cap is passed: traders here pay only half.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.pasar.s: A sealed crate holds %s units, stamped by this town. A crate opened on the road fails its contract; open it only inside a town.
Eight units of one good become one sealed Peti Dagang for cargo contracts.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.rute: %s: buy in %s (%s), sell in %s (%s) · +%s a unit
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.rute_ku: Needs prices from two towns (≤ 3 days old) to work out a route.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dagang.saudaga: %s NB more to the title Merchant of Five Towns
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dokumen.habis: The harbour master gives you no more chances today.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dokumen.kosong: No manifests on the desk yet.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dokumen.kunci: 1-3 pick a manifest · click a line to circle it · Space accuse
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dokumen.pilih_: First pick the manifest you suspect.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.dokumen.tips: Compare weight, seal and date with the customs ledger.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.galangan.kelas: An outrigger river boat: light, quick on canals, room for two.
A two-masted sect ship with a cabin: slow to build, but storm-proof and carries your disciples.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.galangan.koson: The slipway is in use. Come back tomorrow.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.galangan.layar: The new sails are sewn overnight and rigged on your moored ship.
The sail-maker has gone to market.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.galangan.siap: Your ship is afloat and waiting at the shipyard berth.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.galangan.ucap: I have dried this spirit teak for three seasons. What hull shall I lay for you, child?
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.galangan.ucap_: Patience. A hurried keel cracks on the first wave.
She is done! Touch the hull, feel the wood breathe.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.gelap.asal_gel: Righteous guards confiscate dark-origin goods when they find them.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.gelap.gentar_t: How much the demon city fears you. Rises with contracts and arena fights.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.gelap.infami_t: Your ill fame among the righteous. Their hunters come more often.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.gelap.kosong: This stall is empty tonight. Its shadow has left.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.gelap.penyusup: The righteous are known by their walk. The shadows close their stalls.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.beli_kos: The herb racks are empty. The pickers have not come down yet.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.cincin_j: One ring per age mark: 1, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000 years.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.jual_jel: The price is half the value. Old herbs fetch far more.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.jual_kos: Nothing in your bag that the hall buys.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.nilai_je: The healer reads a herb's age from the rings of its stem. Herbs centuries old are worth a fortune to alchemists.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.pegang: Hold a herb in your main hand
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.peringka: Points come from herbs you sell to the hall and from picker missions.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.puncak: Highest rank. The mountain knows your name.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.ucap: Every root here was picked from cliffs climbed only with rope and prayer.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.ucap_jua: Show me your pickings. The hall pays half their value, an honest mountain price.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.ucap_nil: Let me see... cut across, count the rings. The mountain cannot lie.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.ucap_per: Honest pickers rise in rank. Greedy pickers fall off the cliff.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.herba.ucap_tan: Hold the herb you want appraised. Appraisals here are free.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.irama.kunci: Space start · arrows or W A S D
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.irama.mulai: Press the arrow key just as a note crosses the gold ring. Exact = Pas!, slightly off = Baik.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.irama.tanpa_la: There is no rhythm to play yet.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kafilah.badai: Sandstorm! No caravan leaves until it passes.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kafilah.kawal_: Take the guild mission kawal_unta first.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kafilah.per_ha: %s NB a day · faster than walking, never sinks in quicksand
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kafilah.pilih: Pick a caravan from the schedule
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kafilah.tidur_: On the road you may sleep in the saddle: the screen darkens briefly and the caravan is 300 blocks further (not while danger is near).
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kafilah.ucap: Sand never lies. Ride with us, or hire a camel of your own.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kafilah.ucap_b: The camels are kneeling already. Wait for the sand wall to pass.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kapal.badai: Storm at sea! No ship sails until the sky calms.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kapal.badai_be: Loading goes on during the storm; only sailing stops.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kapal.belum_da: No ship is moored yet. See the berth schedule below.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kapal.lintas_j: The ship takes you to the docks of the Endless Sea. The Homeward Gate there brings you back to this harbour.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kapal.muatan_k: The hold is empty. The porters have unloaded it all.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kapal.ucap_bad: Hear those waves? No sane captain sails now.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kapal.ucap_lin: The Endless Sea has no shore, but it has docks. Come aboard, we sail on time.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kitab.pilih_la: Pick an open floor of the tower.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kitab.rak_koso: This floor's shelves are bare. Mo Wen has sold them all.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kitab.segel: The ninth floor is sealed. No one has opened it.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kitab.ucap: I need no eyes to know you tremble. Every floor asks for more nerve.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kontrak.aturan: Only demonic beasts, rival demonic groups, bandits and righteous hunters. Never townsfolk, villagers, disciples or players.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kontrak.belum: The target is not done yet.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kontrak.kosong: The board is empty. Every debt of blood is paid tonight.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.kontrak.pilih: Pick a notice on the board
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.lift.alasan_tu: The cable car is closed tonight.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.lift.arah.naik: The next cabin goes up to the summit.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.lift.arah.turu: The next cabin goes down to the valley.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.lift.macet: The rope is jammed! The cabin is stuck until the bull wheel is mended.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.lift.malam: Night: the cable car is closed. Open %s.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.lift.penuh: The cabin is full; wait for the next one.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.lift.ucap: Hold tight, don't look down. Unless you like the view.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.lift.ucap_mace: That old bull wheel is coughing again. Patience, I'm hitting it lovingly.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.lift.ucap_mala: The rope sleeps at night, and so do I. Come back when the rooster crows.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.mural.dilukis: Mo Hua is painting it. Done %s.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.mural.kosong: This cliff wall is still bare.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.mural.penjelas: Pick one deed on the left. The painting is done in three days and stays on the cliff for good.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.mural.prestasi: Nothing worth painting yet. Earn a title, defeat a boss or survive a tribulation.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.mural.selesai: Your mural is in the twelfth niche now, seen by every traveller in this world.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.mural.ucap_pes: Tell me your greatest deed. I paint it in the twelfth niche, and everyone who passes will see it.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.racik.bahan_ku: You do not have enough materials.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.racik.jelas.1: Set the fire and the time. The glass must melt evenly, without bubbles.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.racik.jelas.2: Pick the stone and the pressure. A wrong curve scatters the light.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.racik.jelas.3: Pick the polishing powder. A clear lens carries the beacon to the horizon.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.racik.panas_ti: Green band: the right heat for salt glass.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.racik.ucap.1: Sea-salt glass is stubborn. Too cold and it cracks, too hot and it boils.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.racik.ucap.2: Grind slowly. The whetstone never hurries, so why should you?
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.racik.ucap.3: Now polish until you can see the stars inside it.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.sutra.dijahit: The tailors are embroidering the motif in gold thread.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.sutra.pilih_du: Pick a dye and a motif first.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.sutra.siap: Your robe is sewn and folded in scented paper.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.sutra.tenun_at: Once a day. Keep the cloth you weave or sell it.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.sutra.tenun_be: The loom rests until tomorrow morning.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.sutra.tenun_je: Press the right direction as the shuttle passes. Three rounds, each faster.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.sutra.tunggu: Your robe is still with the tailors.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.sutra.ucap: Our cloud silk is woven from cocoons fed on mist dew. Feel it, light as a breath.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.sutra.ucap_ten: This loom was my grandmother's. Follow its rhythm, never fight the thread.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.taruhan.batas: Tonight's betting limit is used up.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.taruhan.belum_: No bout announced yet. The next gong is soon.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.taruhan.juara: You stand atop the Blood Ladder. Every challenger now comes for you.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.taruhan.kunci: click a fighter · 1-3 step · Space bet
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.taruhan.tangga: Ladder bouts are never to the death: the referee stops the loser.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.taruhan.ucap_t: Nine rungs, nine bloods. Climb if you dare, come down if your bones break.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawanan.batas: The cells open only three times a day.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawanan.kosong: There are no captives in the cells.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawanan.pilih: Pick a captive to hear their story
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawanan.pulang: %s is free and on the way home to %s.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawanan.tebusa: No money: win a special bout in the Blood Arena against a fighter one tier stronger, and this captive goes home.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawanan.ucap: They are not goods, only debts unpaid. Pay, and they may go home.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawanan.ucap_k: The cells are empty tonight. That is rare.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawar.awas_ren: Too low: the trader may take offence.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawar.belum_ad: The trader has not named a price yet.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawar.menolak: The trader will not sell this today any more. Try other goods or come back tomorrow.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawar.putaran_: All three rounds are used. Accept his price or leave.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.tawar.suasana_: Below 20 he refuses to sell this until tomorrow.
Friendly in the morning, short-tempered in the noon heat. Offers far too low anger him.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.teh.aktif_jela: Its virtue still flows in your meridians.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.teh.terkuat: Only the strongest tea works; a weaker one never replaces it.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.teh.ucap: Sit. The canal water is clear this morning; the tea will be honest with you.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.teh.upacara_je: Lu Yuqing brews for you in three pourings.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.teh.upacara_ti: The ceremony is once a day.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.ziarah.restu: Summit Blessing: 7 days after the pilgrimage
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.ziarah.tandai: Click to mark it on the map
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.ziarah.ucap.ba: The mountain is not angry, only waiting. Try again when your feet are ready.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.ziarah.ucap.be: A thousand steps, nine landings, one day. Your own feet, no wings, no ropes.
Light the lantern on every landing. The mountain counts each step you take.
kultivator.tempat_tema_ui.ziarah.ucap.se: The summit has received you. Carry its blessing down humbly.
